title: Ammonia - NH3 - Concentration in Air and Health Effects
description: Ammonia and health symptoms - smell and threat to life. Analyze ammonia concentration levels in air and their corresponding health effects and safety limits.

components.content:
## Ammonia (NH3) Health Effects Reference

Ammonia is a colorless gas with a very sharp odor commonly used as a refrigerant. In small concentrations it is detectable by smell, but in high concentrations it is an immediate hazard to life.

### Health Effects by Concentration Level:

| Concentration (ppm) | Health Symptoms |
|---|---|
| < 25 | Detectable by smell. Maximum Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL) |
| 30 | Uncomfortable, breathing support required. Maximum exposure 15 minutes |
| 50 | OSHA maximum exposure limit |
| 100 | Irritated eyes, throat and mucous membranes. Mild irritation, may develop tolerance in 1-2 weeks |
| 140 | Moderate eye irritation, no long-term effect in exposures less than 2 hours |
| 400 | Moderate throat irritation. Damage of mucous membranes with more than one hour exposure |
| 500 | Immediate danger to life limit (IDLH) |
| 1000 | Caustic to airway |
| 1700 | Fatal after short exposures - less than half an hour |
| 5000 | Immediate hazard to life |
| > 15000 | Full body protection required |
| 160000 - 170000 | Flammable in air at 50°C |

**Lower Flammable Limit (LFL):** 15-16% by volume

outputs.formula: IF(inputs.concentration_ppm < 25, 'Detectable by smell - Safe', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 30, 'Uncomfortable - Breathing support required', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 50, 'OSHA exposure limit', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 100, 'Eye/throat irritation - Monitor', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 140, 'Moderate eye irritation - Limit to <2 hours', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 400, 'Moderate throat irritation - Limit to <1 hour', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 500, 'IDLH - Danger to life', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 1000, 'Caustic to airway - Severe hazard', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 1700, 'Fatal risk - less than 30 min', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 5000, 'Immediate hazard to life', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 15000, 'Full body protection required', 'Extreme hazard - Flammable')))))))))))

outputs.label: Safety Recommendation
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.concentration_ppm < 25, 'Continuous monitoring acceptable', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 30, 'Evacuate if >15 min exposure', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 50, 'Limit to 8-hour TWA', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 100, 'Use respiratory protection', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 140, 'Use respiratory & eye protection', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 400, 'Use respiratory & eye protection - Limit exposure <1 hour', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 500, 'Immediate evacuation required - Use SCBA', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 1000, 'Immediate evacuation - Full protection required', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 1700, 'Immediate evacuation - Life-threatening', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 5000, 'Immediate evacuation - Self-rescue only', IF(inputs.concentration_ppm <= 15000, 'Full body protection & immediate evacuation', 'Consider flammability hazard - Full protection'))))))))))))
